biotools.summary: perturb_seq provides a simple baseline method for predicting genetic perturbation effects on the transcriptome, outperforming state-of-the-art deep learning algorithms. The software includes corrected versions of popular datasets used for benchmarking perturbation prediction models, facilitating reproducible research in the field.
